label: Unique existence and at-most-one connection plan
summary: The generic certificate factors existence and at-most-one for one predicate. The existing classical God assembly already combines existence and uniqueness. Any new use must identify one shared IsGod predicate and a genuine consumer of a unique witness, such as attribute agreement across two existing witnesses. Repeating the same conjunction adds no support. Introduced in e230c1d4a.
blocker: Connection target 33b18ae7-4578-54bc-a2b5-edce99b21fc2. The scoped bridge described in the summary remains open.
